rawContent: I love this discourse being the comparative analysis of  #MarchForOurLives and #BlackLivesMatter. I do want to correct the notion celebrities didn't give to BLM when many did just some were done stealth cuz of worry of pushback.
Most of the famous men who've been called out via the #MeToo movement have MULTIPLE compliants. Not just 1 person alleging sexual harassment or abuse.
